basic_details.job_title: MGUVV Guest Teacher Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Mahatma Gandhi University of Horticulture and Forestry, Durg (MGUVV) has notified 3 temporary Guest Teacher vacancies for Vegetable Science, Floriculture and Land Scaping Architecture, and Agronomy posts, with applications to be submitted on or before 26 October 2026. Eligible candidates must apply offline by sending the prescribed application form through Speed Post or Registered Post to DEAN, COLLEGE OF HORTICULTURE AND RESEARCH STATION, RAMANUJGANJ, ITI, Building, Kamalpur, Distt. Qualifications and pay vary by post, offering Rs. 1,800 per working day up to a maximum of Rs. 40,000 per month

age_limit.details: Maximum age limit is 40 years. Five (05) years relaxation will be given for SC, ST, OBC and women candidates as per C.G. Govt. rules.

qualification.details: Vegetable Science: Master degree in subject Vegetable Science, Floriculture and Land Scaping Architecture and Agronomy at least 55% marks (or its equivalent grade 6.50 in 10:00 scales) with good academic record. Floriculture and Land Scaping Architecture & Agronomy: For candidates having Master's degree, NET (National Eligibility Test) shall remain compulsory along with one publication in NAAS (National Academy of Ag. Science, New Delhi) rated referred journal for recruitment to the post of Assistant Professor/Guest Teacher and equivalent in the disciplines in which NET is conducted. Essentially of NET can be waived off for the candidates holding Ph.D. Degree provided it has been done with course work as prescribed by the UGC Regulations 2009, and the candidates has at least two full length publications having a NAAS rating not less than 4, on the last date of submission of application. Those candidates with Ph.D. degree without course work will not eligible for NET exemption. | Maximum age limit is 40 years. Five (05) years relaxation will be given for SC, ST, OBC and women candidates as per C.G. Govt. rules.

selection_process: Candidates are invited to appear for a Walk-in- Interview for the contractual position of Guest teacher. Selection is based on walk-in-interview.
important_instructions: The candidates shall apply through Speed Post/registered Post only in prescribed format. Incomplete applications shall be rejected. The post of Guest Teacher is purely temporary for Six Month or till the appointment of regular teacher, whichever is earlier. No TA/DA will be provided to candidates for appearing Interview. The candidates shall bring all original documents along with 01 set of photocopy for verification on the date of interview failing which they will not be allowed for appearing in interview. After selection the candidates have to submit affidavit on judicial stamp paper of Rs. 50/- as per format to agree the terms and conditions prescribed by University.

Candidates must appear for the interview on the date and time mentioned with all original documents.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in MGUVV Guest Teacher recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for Guest Teacher posts across Vegetable Science, Floriculture and Land Scaping Architecture, and Agronomy disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 26/10/2026 before 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. When is the interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 03/11/2026 at 10:00 AM onwards at the Office of the Dean, College of Horticulture and Research Station, ITI, Building, Kamalpur, Dist. Balrampur-Ramanujganj (C.G.) 497220.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for MGUVV Guest Teacher posts?
faq.answer: Qualifications include a Master's degree in the relevant subject with at least 55% marks, along with NET or Ph.D. as specified for each individual post in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years, with a 5-year relaxation given for SC, ST, OBC, and women candidates as per Chhattisgarh Government rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply offline by sending their filled application form with self-attested documents via Speed Post or Registered Post to the Dean's office at Ramanujganj.

faq.question: Q8. Is this position permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post of Guest Teacher is purely temporary for six months or until the appointment of a regular teacher, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. What salary is offered to Guest Teachers?
faq.answer: The honorarium ranges from Rs. 1,200 to Rs. 1,800 per working day, up to a maximum monthly cap of Rs. 26,000 to Rs. 40,000 depending on the specific post and qualification.
